title: Write 7 · 太 最 再 呢 次 小 知 道 时 候 走 后 间 今 孩
focus: 太 最 再 呢 次 小 知 道 时 候 走 后 间 今 孩
body:
Repeating parts: 日 sun (最, 时, 间), 口 (呢, 知, 后), 寸 (时), 欠 (次), 子 (孩), 辶 (道).

## Rules that matter here
- **Centre before the sides**: 小 (and 少 in the next lesson).
- **Door frames**: 间 = 门 first, then what's inside; 门 has no bottom to close.
- 再 vs 在 (both zài): 再 'again' is the one with 冂 and a long bottom line.

cards.Notes: 大 big (3) + a dot (1) = 4 strokes. Write 大 fully, then the dot under it last. Lookalike: 犬 (dot on top right).
日 (4) + 取 take (8: 耳 + 又) = 12 strokes. Top before bottom; 耳's last horizontal becomes a rising stroke.
6 strokes: top 一, 丨, 横折钩, middle 一, the central vertical, then the long 一 last. Lookalike: 在 (same sound).
口 mouth (3, particle) + 尼 (5: 尸 + 匕, phonetic ní) = 8 strokes. Left before right.
冫 ice (2) + 欠 (4) = 6 strokes. Watch: two dots 冫, not three 氵. Lookalike: 欢 (又 + 欠).
3 strokes. Centre before sides: the vertical hook first, then the left dot, then the right dot. Lookalike: 少 (adds ノ).
矢 arrow (5) + 口 mouth (3) = 8 strokes. Left before right; 矢's ㇏ shrinks to a dot. Lookalike: 和 (禾 + 口).
首 head (9: 丷, 一, 自) + 辶 walk (3) = 12 strokes. 首 first, 辶 LAST.
日 sun (4) + 寸 (3) = 7 strokes. Left before right; 寸's dot last. Lookalike: 对 (又 + 寸).
亻 (2) + a short 丨 (1) + 𠂉 + 矢-like part (7) = 10 strokes. Trap: don't forget the thin vertical; without it it's 侯 hóu.
土 (3) + a 止-like base (4) = 7 strokes. Top before bottom; the long ㇏ at the bottom right is last. Radical in 起.
厂-like top (ノ, 一, long ノ) + 口 (3) = 6 strokes. Top short ノ first. Lookalike: 石 (一 on top).
门 door (3) + 日 sun (4) = 7 strokes. Write 门 first, then 日 inside (门 has no bottom to close). Sun through a door gap.
人 (2) + dot + ㇇ = 4 strokes. Top before bottom. Lookalike: 令 lìng (5 strokes, an extra stroke at the bottom).
子 child (3) + 亥 (6, phonetic hài) = 9 strokes. On the left, 子's last horizontal becomes a rising stroke. Lookalike: 该 (讠).
